note: Evidence register only. A requirement passes only with status PASS, an author and a distinct named independent reviewer, and evidence of the one kind that requirement accepts, where each item's path resolves to an artifact whose SHA-256 matches; identity rows must bind qualified_identity to the measured_sha256 in their evidence. Physical rows accept only OEM/target/bench/vehicle evidence. This is an integrity check, not authentication. Editing this file grants no authority: no production code reads it.
